title: Garin backs 2027 medical aid shift, cites 11% fund use

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Deputy Speaker Janette Garin on Saturday defended the realignment of health funds toward patient assistance under the proposed 2027 national budget, citing unspent vaccine allocations and a sluggish 11-percent utilization rate for the government’s health facility program. Speaking at the Saturday News Forum in Quezon City, the former health secretary welcomed public scrutiny over the budget changes, saying lawmakers needed to address misconceptions surrounding health sector funding. Garin pointed to untouched allocations for flu shots, as well as unspent 2025 and 2026 funds earmarked for pediatric pneumonia vaccines, as primary reasons for the realignment.
